messages.author: 4c1108aaddb5744d
messages.subject: how to constrain x-axis
parts:
Hi ggplot users,

I want to ask about time problem. The input dataset includes two years, 2006 and 2007, this is for x-axis. The y-axis are some other parameters. The x-axis for 2006 and 2007 are from 1-365 and 1-365. I convert it to year, month and day of month, such as 2006-01-01, 2006-12-31. When drawing the plot, how to limit x-axis to just year 2007. That is to say, the smallest number on x-axis is 2007-01-01? I use xlim=c(2007-01-01,2008-12-31) but it doesn't work. Thanks for your help.

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: Re: how to constrain x-axis
parts:
probably just:

+ coord_cartesian(xlim = c("2007-01-01","2008-12-31"))

however, i am not sure how to handle dates here. Maybe:

+ coord_cartesian(xlim = c(as.Date("2007-01-01"),as.Date("2008-12-31")))
